verdict.rationale: Nix's core design (derivations, Nix store paths keyed by hash, flakes with lockfiles, nix-shell/nix develop environments) inherently pins exact versions of packages and dependencies per project, and multiple package versions can coexist without conflict, with community testimony confirming reliable reproducible builds across teams. missing for 10: explicit per-project version pinning workflow docs (e.g. flake.lock pinning walkthrough), independent hands-on verification that pins are strictly respected across machines, and coverage of edge cases like impure inputs breaking pins.
